title: Safe sync: gone versus did not answer
lede: A sync is a set of parts, one per provider and scope. If every part answered, an agent not seen is gone. If any part failed, nothing is deleted and an agent not seen is unknown, never gone. Lab reading of a partly-cut-off deck line. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Unknown: provider did not answer; nothing deleted

edges.label: complete run: not seen means gone
partial run: not seen means unknown

steps.title: Ask every part
steps.what: The controller asks each provider for each scope.

steps.title: Answers or silence
steps.what: A part either answers with its agents or does not answer at all.

steps.title: Compare
steps.what: The run is compared with what the inventory already holds.

steps.title: Complete run
steps.what: Every part answered: an agent that was not seen is marked gone.

steps.title: Partial run
steps.what: At least one part failed: nothing is deleted and every unseen agent is marked unknown.

steps.title: Status only
steps.what: The inventory records the marks. A later complete run recovers or confirms them.
